review.recommendation: Part A is complete. The text at PreCompact works without Context Mode: I 0.983 against O 0.787, I minus O +0.196 (bootstrap interval over tasks +0.125 to +0.275, 12 pairs, 11 wins, 1 tie, 0 losses). The earlier result holds in isolated sessions: R 0.950 against B 0.719, R minus B +0.232 (interval +0.102 to +0.346). No stop rule applies. Arm B is 0.069 below the plain host (interval -0.211 to +0.098), and the cause is open. Arms B and R ran with the clock on and the feedback off, not with the clock off as the design file says. No arm had Context Mode with the clock off. For part B, replace arm Y with arm A (clock off). 4 runs of D12-backup-policy (both of arm B, both of arm O) have a denied attempt to read the session transcript. They stay valid by the current rule. Exploratory sample, no significance claim.
